notes.title: Minor Gameplay Adjustments and Bug Fixes Update Log - 2025.09.14 v1.0.4A
notes.notes: [p]Good Sunday, Your Majesty. We have implemented some further updates and fixes to the game. Details are as follows:[/p][olist][*][p]Bug fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]The effect of the "Celestial Mandate" event will now be removed upon entering Endless Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased clearance rewards on certain difficulty levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new low-difficulty mode, accessible via the leftmost button in the difficulty tab on the mode selection screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted certain sound effects.[/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"]Happy weekend![/p]

notes.title: Minor Gameplay Adjustments and Bug Fixes Update Log - 2025.09.13 v1.03B
notes.notes: [p]Good afternoon, Your Majesty. We have implemented further updates and fixes to the game. Details are as follows:[/p][olist][*][p]Bug fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the numerical color of card corner icons—each stacking value now has a unique color indicator.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the difficulty of certain crisis challenges.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the appearance rates of certain cards and policies—higher-quality cards and policies are now more likely to appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional sound effects.[/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"]We hope you enjoy the game! You are also cordially invited to join our [url="https://discord.gg/HyRzbWvpxN"]Discord [/url]to discuss court affairs together![/p]

notes.title: Please feel free to provide your feedback, Your Majesty!
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Your Majesty!
We have prepared a survey to make it convenient for you to report any bugs encountered. If you have suggestions for improving the game, you are also welcome to share them directly through this survey! We will carefully review every piece of feedback you submit![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Survey link:[/b][/p][p][b][url="https://wj.qq.com/s2/23849903/ef31/"]https://wj.qq.com/s2/23849903/ef31/[/url][/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Minor Gameplay Adjustments and Bug Fixes - 2025.09.12
notes.notes: [p]Dear Your Majesty,[/p][p]We have made some adjustments to the gameplay and fixed known bugs. The update details are as follows:[/p][olist][*][p]Fixed several bugs and mechanics that affected gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted icons for certain units.[/p][/*][*][p]Clearing stage "New Policy Dawns" now rewards 1 \[Ballad of Triumph].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the efficiency of \[Ballad of Triumph] generation when \[Imperial Concubine] removes units.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the chance for the \[Seven Stars] Reform to generate \[Ballad of Triumph].[/p][/*][*][p]Raised the maximum attempts of card rerolls allowed per turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the cost curve for rerolling cards, now making it cheaper.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the effect multiplier of the Zodiac Loong on cards of corresponding tiers.[/p][/*][*][p]Randomly generated Zodiac signs will no longer be the same as the previous one.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Hope you have a great time! We also sincerely invite you to join our discord and govern together![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/HyRzbWvpxN" style="button"]Join Our Discord ![/url][/p]

notes.title: The time has come, Your Majesty! "It's Time, Your Majesty" is Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]The moment of coronation has arrived! With your father, siblings, and relatives all slain by enemy invaders, you must now make wise decisions. Your Majesty, it is time to hold court![/p][p][/p][p][b]"It's Time, Your Majesty" is now available for purchase at $6,99. With the launch discount of 10% off, you can get it for only $6.29![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/d042b88335a657a663e27448c62c834931aa414b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]"It's Time, Your Majesty" is a casual strategy roguelike game. As the ruler of a nation, you must recruit talents, raise armies, and defend against foreign invasions—or enact policies to strengthen the economy. When the national treasury’s surplus grain can match the number of enemy troops, the people will live in peace, and the realm will prosper.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/c633bc91d3b804a5ca680457e1b8d64902aca86e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/6476c8735a78def08828279b0ece8060b605fb19.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The card-building strategies are diverse—to address early economic weakness, you can peacefully earn income as a goose farmer. Feel like money comes too slowly? You might hire a butcher to sharpen the knives, turn geese into goose meat, and let merchants digest it for greater profits.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/09109a77bad812578d1e77e8abb13ff37dfe43a8.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/53b6a1db88b517d7668c2b592d79019e63894851.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Just want to resist foreign enemies? Then recruit soldiers and expand your army! The "Female Soldier" and "Mulan" cards in the game can merge into the "Women’s Army" after selecting corresponding policies! Who says women are inferior to men![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/ca9e3049dae1de0ae8071e8b5b08b7d7b32632b9.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/c1ba2501a4924a54fdb82135633b831950988c7e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Sometimes random events will catch you off guard—beware of plagues or locust disasters! If you encounter an irreversible situation, remember to make good use of "Reforms" or change the zodiac year to make gains more achievable.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/2a6f6e6390336e9c260389d32b1c12d09e28abd2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The discount is ongoing! Seize the throne and reclaim the realm now![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3164160/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Your Kingdom Awaits. 'It's time,your majesty' Launches Sept 11
notes.notes: [h3]Your Majesty, we have great news![/h3][p][b]"It's time,your majesty" has officially announced its release date—it will launch on Steam on September 11, priced at 5.99$![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/69dc19d7b46706a94352dcbe102ee6b23fd14f77.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As the ruler of a nation, you must recruit talents, muster troops, and defend against the invasion of the Xiongnu. Alternatively, you can formulate policies to strengthen the economy. When the national granary’s surplus can match the strength of foreign threats, the people will live in peace, and the realm will thrive![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/f11aa5e191c17b2570fdf704aa9426e3ac3b3bea.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]At times, random events may catch you off guard—stay vigilant against plagues or locust disasters, adjust your governance strategies, and strive to weather each natural or man-made catastrophe. Managing a vast empire is no easy task, but wisely employing "reforms" or changing the zodiac of the era may just help you turn the tide and usher in a new dawn.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/454992bd4bb2308b649a466e84a467460410ce3f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/47dca6c24685adca7c924cf70ed9e81e197736d3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3164160/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: DEMO Release丨We humbly invite Your Majesty to ascend the throne.
notes.notes:
The rebels in Jiuhua launched a night raid, and the capital city fell. You were entrusted with a mission at this critical moment and took charge of the imperial court!

The country is beset with both internal troubles and external threats. We earnestly implore Your Majesty to suppress the rebels and revive the nation, and skillfully manage this cyber imperial court!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3164160/_/

The DEMO for the class Lucky Landlord game “It's Time, Your Majesty” is now available! In this game, Your Majesty can select talents to enrich the imperial court by choosing cards, formulate national policies and issue government decrees, so as to help the country fill the national treasury and defend against foreign enemies. 

【Game Description】
Construct your deck by “turning over cards”. Different combinations of cards can create different combinations of benefits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/33be28ae02f81d59be8a00b62039f98401387e3b.gif[/img]

Choose different policy cards to match the deck in the card pool, and increase the silver to enrich the national treasury.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/61e68acc591b31625e0cb9fb540ae8790db5f568.gif[/img]

Combine the random events encountered in different years to maximize the revenue of the treasury!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/3ce9375c19d095504c23b5b8674b1f26db778101.gif[/img]

Welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/ukPzA86d8Q]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Your Majesty, The country is on your shoulder now!
notes.notes:
Long live your Majesty！
We have received news today that enemies have invaded our border, and I implore Your Majesty's holy judgement.

Welcome ‘Your Majesty, It's Time ’, sons of heavens. 
It's my honor to greet you all for the first time, and we hope you like our game!

[b]【Gameplay】[/b]
Build your deck by turning over cards. Different combinations of cards can produce different combo benefits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/038f727db781fd20b93e8a3dae9d3513bbb9d1bc.gif[/img]

Choose different policy cards to match the deck in the card pool and increase the silver to enrich the treasury.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/4ae05992474b50685b29483a6ec72f80a802c467.gif[/img]

Combine random events encountered in different years to maximise treasury returns!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/6f5f3c803092c1929056bb7c94c9c94d9484be90.jpg[/img]

May Your Majesty enjoy eternal prosperity and a stable reign.

There are more interesting contents waiting for you to dig out, we will give you a detailed explanation after. We welcome all the sons of heaven to try out the game as well as give some advice. We hope you can add ‘Your Majesty, It's Time ’ to your wish list, our small indie team needs your support very much!

You can also join our Discord, sharing experience with other sons of heaven: https://discord.gg/sEknuszrxE
